{{Top|notoc=1}}
'''Infrared''' was a form of [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> Various [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] and non-sentient [[Species/Legends|species]] could see in the infrared spectrum.

Technologies that used infrared included [[Infrared receptor|infrared scans]] and [[infrared motion sensor]]s. In poorly lit areas, guards would activate devices that could scan with infrared optics.

The planet [[Alpheridies/Legends|Alpheridies]] orbited the [[Red dwarf/Legends|red dwarf]] star [[Aber (star)|Aber]] that emitted energy mostly in the infrared spectrum. Because of this, the [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] gradually lost their ability to see.<ref name="TotJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>
